outputs.explanation: This is a stacked bar chart showing median promoter state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin (an aggregated/summary statistic across n=5912 promoters per bin), but no individual data points (e.g., per-promoter values) are overlaid or shown.

Same as panel A: a stacked bar chart of median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin across mouse promoters, with no individual data points shown.
Single-molecule stack plot showing individual molecules directly (each row = one molecule), so it already displays individual data rather than an average.
